text:
claire (FinOps): Quick sync  We need clarity on invoice backfill and retro-credit policy for the upcoming pricing A/B. Questions: who approves credits, auto vs manual thresholds, and how backfill will show on next invoices?

aj (Billing): I can run the backfill. Proposal: auto-queue credits <= $150, manual review for > $150. Backfill will be visible as a separate line item labelled 'pricing-experiment-adjustment' on next invoice cycle.

maria: Can we ensure grandfathered accounts are never backfilled (i.e., no re-pricing)? Need a clean exclusion list.

aj (Billing): Yes, backfill script will skip any account in `grandfathered_list`. Please upload as `billing_account_id`.

tom (Legal): Approve auto-queue threshold at $150 but require email notification template and audit CSV. For credits > $150 require manager sign-off in the ticket before issuing.

kevin (Revenue Ops): We'll need metrics: number of credits queued, total credits value, and top 10 accounts by delta. I'll add dashboards and an alert if queued credits > $5k/day.

nora (Support): Support macro draft: "Were reviewing a short-term pricing test; any adjustments will appear as a separate credit on your next invoice. If you need faster resolution, open a ticket and well prioritize." I'll post it here.

sam (Engineering): Backfill runbook question: does the script write adjustments into billing DB or write a reconciliation file for accounting to ingest? I prefer generating a CSV for manual ingestion to avoid accidental double-charges.

aj (Billing): Good point. Backfill will produce a reconciliations CSV + create a hold record. The actual credit application will be a separate safe job that can be toggled. Default: generate CSV and queue; ops run will apply after manual QA for >$150.

claire (FinOps): Timeline: we want a dry-run of backfill on staging tomorrow 03:00 PT and CSV in the drive for review. If dry-run looks good, apply small auto-queue for <=$150 on day-2 of the experiment.

ops-bot: Backfill job scheduled (staging): ./tools/billing/backfill --env staging --cohort ab_v3 --dry-run at 2029-04-12T03:00:00-07:00.

aj (Billing): I'll open PR with the script and runbook and post dry-run summary here.

claire (FinOps): Thanks all. Final: upload grandfathered CSV by EOD and legal will sign the policy. We'll reconvene here in morning for go/no-go.
